arxiv-2101-01971.title: HIP and HEP
arxiv-2101-01971.creator: Urs Achim Wiedemann
arxiv-2101-01971.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Urs Achim Wiedemann. This write-up of the ICHEP plenary “Heavy Ions - theory” focusses on some recent LHC discoveries and future opportunities in heavy ion physics (HIP) that are at the intersection with high energy physics (HEP). High energy physics (HEP) investigates the elementary constituents of matter and their interactions, but part
of its motivation and guidance arises from embedding HEP in the thermal history of our Universe.

arxiv-2109-10634.title: Filtered integration rules for finite Hilbert transforms Journal: Arxiv
arxiv-2109-10634.creator: Donatella Occorsio, Maria Grazia Russo, Woula Themistoclakis
arxiv-2109-10634.description: Abstract A product quadrature rule, based on the filtered de la Vallée Poussin polynomial approximation, is proposed for evaluating the finite Hilbert transform in [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . Convergence results are stated in weighted uniform norm for functions belonging to suitable Besov type subspaces.

arxiv-2109-14591.title: Combining Human Predictions with Model Probabilities via Confusion Matrices and Calibration
arxiv-2109-14591.creator: Gavin Kerrigan, Padhraic Smyth, Mark Steyvers
arxiv-2109-14591.description: Abstract An increasingly common use case for machine learning models is augmenting the abilities of human decision makers. For classification tasks where neither the human or model are perfectly accurate, a key step in obtaining high performance is combining their individual predictions in a manner that leverages their relative strengths.

arxiv-2204-06617.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Panagiotis Dimakis. In this paper we prove existence for model knot solutions to the dimensionally reduced twisted Kapustin-Witten equations on ℝ + 3 \mathbb{R}^{3}_{+} for any twisting parameter t ∈ ( 0 , ∞ ) t\in(0,\infty) . arxiv-2208-07430.title: Topological duality for orthomodular lattices This article is forthcoming in Mathematical Logic Quarterly (2023). Joseph McDonald was supported as a research assistant by the SSHRC-IG #435–2019–0331 of Katalin Bimbó. We thank the anonymous referee for their very helpful comments. We also thank the a
arxiv-2208-07430.creator: Joseph McDonald, Katalin Bimbó
arxiv-2208-07430.description: Abstract A class of ordered relational topological spaces is described, which we call orthomodular spaces . Our construction of these spaces involves adding a topology to the class of orthomodular frames introduced by Hartonas, along the lines of Bimbó’s topologization of the class of orthoframes employed by Goldblatt in his representation of ortholattices.

arxiv-2302-03895.title: AdS/BCFT with Brane-Localized Scalar Field
arxiv-2302-03895.creator: Hiroki Kanda
arxiv-2302-03895.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the dynamics of end-of-the-world (EOW) branes in AdS with scalar fields localized on the branes as a new class of gravity duals of CFTs on manifolds with boundaries. This allows us to construct explicit solutions dual to boundary RG flows.

arxiv-2307-12085.description: Abstract We study the limiting distribution of dense orbits of a lattice subgroup Γ ≤ SL ​ ( m + 1 , ℝ ) \Gamma\leq\text{SL}(m+1,\mathbb{R}) acting on H \ SL ​ ( m + 1 , ℝ ) H\backslash\text{SL}(m+1,\mathbb{R}) , with respect to a filtration of growing norm balls.

arxiv-2307-15400.title: The FlySpeech Audio-Visual Speaker Diarization System for MISP Challenge 2022
arxiv-2307-15400.creator: Li Zhang 1 , Huan Zhao 1 , Yue Li 1 , Bowen Pang 1 , Yannan Wang 2 , Hongji Wang 2 , Wei Rao 2 , Qing Wang 1 , Lei Xie 1 , ∗ {}^{1,^{*}}
arxiv-2307-15400.description: Abstract This paper describes the FlySpeech speaker diarization system submitted to the second M ultimodal I nformation Based S peech P rocessing ( MISP ) Challenge held in ICASSP 2022. We develop an end-to-end audio-visual speaker diarization (AVSD) system, which consists of a lip encoder, a speaker encoder, and an audio-visual decoder.

arxiv-2412-06896.title: The Pristine Inner Galaxy Survey (PIGS)
arxiv-2412-06896.creator: Sara Vitali, Alvaro Rojas-Arriagada, Paula Jofré, Federico Sestito, Joshua Povick, Vanessa Hill, Emma Fernández-Alvar, Anke Ardern-Arentsen, Pascale Jablonka, Nicolas F. Martin, Else Starkenburg, David Aguado
arxiv-2412-06896.description: Abstract Context. The Sagittarius dwarf spheroidal galaxy (Sgr dSph) is a satellite orbiting the Milky Way that has experienced multiple stripping events due to tidal interactions with our Galaxy. Its accretion history has led to a distinct stellar overdensity, which is the remnant of the core of the progenitor. Aims.

arxiv-2505-03528.title: Coop-WD: Cooperative Perception with Weighting and Denoising for Robust V2V Communication Thanks: This work was supported in part by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council: Communications Hub For Empowering Distributed ClouD Computing Applications And Research (CHEDDAR) (EP/X040518/1
arxiv-2505-03528.creator: Chenguang Liu, Jianjun Chen, Yunfei Chen, Fellow, IEEE, Yubei He, Zhuangkun Wei
arxiv-2505-03528.description: Abstract Cooperative perception, leveraging shared information from multiple vehicles via vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication, plays a vital role in autonomous driving to alleviate the limitation of single-vehicle perception. Existing works have explored the effects of V2V communication impairments on perception precision, but they lack generalization to different levels of impairments.

arxiv-2506-21408.title: Scalable Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models via Stochastic Variational Subspace Inference
arxiv-2506-21408.creator: Colin Samplawski, Adam D. Cobb, Manoj Acharya, Ramneet Kaur, Susmit Jha
arxiv-2506-21408.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Colin Samplawski, Adam D. Cobb, Manoj Acharya, Ramneet Kaur, Susmit Jha. Despite their widespread use, large language models (LLMs) are known to hallucinate incorrect information and be poorly calibrated. This makes the uncertainty quantification of these models of critical importance, especially in high-stakes domains, such as autonomy and healthcare. Prior work has made Bayesian deep learning-based approaches to this problem more tractable by performing inference over the low-rank adaptation (LoRA) parameters of a fine-tuned model.

arxiv-2509-15286.title: Global Spin Alignment of (Anti-) 4 Li in Non-Central Heavy-Ion Collisions
arxiv-2509-15286.creator: Yun-Peng Zheng, Dai-Neng Liu, Lie-Wen Chen, Jin-Hui Chen, Che Ming Ko, Yu-Gang Ma, Kai-Jia Sun, Jun Xu, Bo Zhou
arxiv-2509-15286.description: Abstract Non-central heavy-ion collisions produce hot and dense nuclear matter with significant fluid vorticity, which can induce global polarizations or alignments of particles with non-zero spins along the direction of the total orbital angular momentum. This phenomenon has been observed for hyperons and vector mesons in experiments.

arxiv-2510-07571.title: What is the most optimal diffusion?
arxiv-2510-07571.creator: Vasili Baranau vasili.baranov@gmail.com
arxiv-2510-07571.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vasili Baranau vasili.baranov@gmail.com. What is the fastest possible “diffusion”? A trivial answer would be “a process that converts a Dirac delta-function into a uniform distribution infinitely fast”. Below, we consider a more reasonable formulation: a process that maximizes differential entropy of a probability density function (pdf) f ⁡ ( x → , t ) f(\vec{x},t) at every time t t , under certain restrictions. Specifically, we focus on a case when the rate of the Kullback–Leibler divergence D KL D_{\text{KL}} is fixed.

arxiv-2601-00786.title: Callisto’s Non-Resonant Orbit as an Outcome of Circum-Jovian Disk Substructure
arxiv-2601-00786.creator: Teng Ee Yap, Konstantin Batygin
arxiv-2601-00786.description: Abstract The Galilean moons of Io, Europa, and Ganymede exhibit a 4:2:1 commensurability in their mean motions, a configuration known as the Laplace resonance. The prevailing view for the origin of this three-body resonance involves the convergent migration of the moons, resulting from gas-driven torques in the circum-Jovian disk wherein they accreted.

pmc-10604619.title: Development of Piperazine- and Oxazine-Linked Pyrimidines as p65 Subunit Binders of NF–κB in Human Breast Cancer Cells
pmc-10604619.creator: Akshay Ravish, Bhanuprakash C. Narasimhachar, Zhang Xi, Divakar Vishwanath, Arunkumar Mohan, Santosh L. Gaonkar, Paduvalahippe Gowdegowda Chandrashekara, Kwang Seok Ahn, Vijay Pandey, Peter E. Lobie, Basappa Basappa
pmc-10604619.description: Nuclear factor kappa B (NF–κB) is a potential therapeutic target in breast cancer. In the current study, a new class of oxazine– and piperazine–linked pyrimidines was developed as inhibitors of NF–κB, overcoming the complexity of the oxazine structure found in nature and enabling synthesis under laboratory conditions.

pmc-10747402.title: Viral–Bacterial Interactions That Impact Viral Thermostability and Transmission
pmc-10747402.creator: Lorimar Robledo Gonzalez, Rachel P Tat, Justin C Greaves, Christopher M Robinson, Ulrich Desselberger
pmc-10747402.description: Enteric viruses are significant human pathogens that commonly cause foodborne illnesses worldwide. These viruses initiate infection in the gastrointestinal tract, home to a diverse population of intestinal bacteria. In a novel paradigm, data indicate that enteric viruses utilize intestinal bacteria to promote viral replication and pathogenesis.

pmc-11334117.title: Diagnostic delay in ankle and foot tuberculosis resulting in tuberculoma and tuberculous meningitis in a middle-aged female: A case report
pmc-11334117.creator: Hedwiga F Swai, Sibtain M Moledina, Sylvia B Nsato, Amina Mgunya, Joan Rugemalila, Veridiana Byemelwa, Sharon Ismail, Pauline Chale, Luth Mwapule, Alex Masao, Jude Tarimo, Amunga Meda, Fatuma Muhali, May Shoo, Eva Uiso, Stella Rwezaura, Eliaichi Minja, Deogratius Beda, Sarah K Nyagabona, Onesmo Kisa
pmc-11334117.description: A middle-aged woman presents with chronic foot arthritis which progressed to a non-healing ulcer, which was unresponsive to conventional antibiotics and debridement. She then developed cerebral manifestations and was empirically treated with antitubercular medications which led to healing of the ulcer.

pmc-11442496.title: Pharmacokinetics and pharmacogenomics of ribociclib in black patients with metastatic breast cancer the LEANORA study
pmc-11442496.creator: Ilana Schlam, D Max Smith, Cody Peer, Tristan Sissung, Keith T Schmidt, Ming Tan, Ami Chitalia, Nanette H Bishopric, Seth Steinberg, Hyoyoung Choo-Wosoba, Giulia Napoli, Christopher Gallagher, Nadia Ashai, Kristen Whitaker, Candace Mainor, Shruti Tiwari, Nicole Swanson, Stacy Malloy, Claudine Isaacs
pmc-11442496.description: Underrepresented populations’ participation in clinical trials remains limited, and the potential impact of genomic variants on drug metabolism remains elusive. This study aimed to assess the pharmacokinetics (PK) and pharmacogenomics (PGx) of ribociclib in self-identified Black women with hormone receptor-positive (HR+)/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2) advanced breast cancer.

pmc-12432052.title: Temporal variability in dissolved organic matter composition export in streams
pmc-12432052.creator: Most Shirina Begum, Meredith Kadjeski, Christina Fasching, Marguerite A Xenopoulos
pmc-12432052.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Export of dissolved organic carbon (DOC) from freshwater systems has been the focus of many studies owing to its pivotal role in regulating global carbon fluxes and ecosystem function. Both the flux and composition of dissolved organic matter (DOM) are critical for understanding its ecological impact, as similar compositions can have vastly different consequences depending on the magnitude of input and hydrological context. However, very little data exists on the composition of DOM export fluxes to downstream ecosystems.

pmc-12638917.title: Dynamic conditional survival nomogram for non-early-stage infiltrating ductal carcinoma based on SEER database
pmc-12638917.creator: Erqing Tan, Tingting Chen, He Hao, Wenbin Gao, Shuding Guo, Heyang Cui, Bin Song
pmc-12638917.description: The prognosis of breast cancer varies by histologic subtype, with infiltrating ductal carcinoma (IDC) being the most prevalent, comprising 70% of infiltrating breast cancers. Long-term survival outcomes for IDC remain unclear, and some non-early-stage IDC patients exhibit better survival than initially expected.

pmc-12642109.title: Adding tibial nerve neurodynamic techniques to a rehabilitative pain management strategy improved neuropathy severity and quality of life in patients with diabetic peripheral neuropathy: a randomized sham-controlled trial
pmc-12642109.creator: Mahdi Ashoori, Seyed Ebrahim Hashemi, Mohammadreza Pourahmadi, Mehdi Dadgoo, Mahboobeh Sadat Hosseini, Hasti Lotfi, Maryam Ahmadi
pmc-12642109.description: BackgroundDiabetic Peripheral Neuropathy (DPN), affects 30% of type 2 diabetics, leading to severe foot problems. Existing treatments offer limited efficacy. This randomized controlled trial explores Neurodynamic Techniques (NDTs) for their impact on neuropathy severity, quality of life (QoL), nerve function, range of motion (ROM), and nerve mechanosensitivity in DPN patients.

pmc-12963116.title: Fruit weight regulation by a paralog of Cell Size Regulator (CSR) in tomato and other crops
pmc-12963116.creator: Qian Feng, Lara Pereira, Manoj Sapkota, Krishna Sai Karnatam, Yanbing Wang, Padma Nimmakayala, Umesh K Reddy, Esther van der Knaap
pmc-12963116.description: Key messageA paralog of Cell Size Regulator (CSR), CSR-like1, underlies the novel fw6.2 QTL in tomato. The gene and locus regulate fruit weight by increasing pericarp cell size and its function on fruit weight appears to be conserved in other crops.

pmc-13556522.title: 375. Sex differences in time-based impulsive action in adolescent rats: role of NMDA receptor antagonism
pmc-13556522.creator: R-M Liao, Y-J Wang, C Li, Y-C Lin, Z-L Li, H-W Hung, P-X Xiao, F Yin, Y-J Lin, S-Y Yeh
pmc-13556522.description: BackgroundAdolescents are often impulsive, and their behavior frequently lacks inhibitory control and temporal regulation. In the domain of impulsive action, sex differences have been demonstrated in waiting impulsivity, as measured by the five-choice serial reaction time task, in adolescent rats. However, it remains unclear whether sex differences exist in timing impulsivity.

the-tavern-knight.title: The Tavern Knight
the-tavern-knight.creator: Sabatini, Rafael
the-tavern-knight.description: Eighteen years ago, Sir Crispin Galliard, the Tavern Knight in service of King Charles, was another man -- a man with another name, a man who had a life, a future, and a heritage -- including hereditary lands and titles that would come to him in time.
